description: This file defines a data source for paginated loading of Product objects in an Android app, leveraging Paging 3 library features. It implements the PagingSource class and manages fetching pages from the ProductRepository.

classes.name: ProductPagingSource
classes.description: A PagingSource implementation that retrieves pages of Product objects from a repository.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a page of products asynchronously based on the provided LoadParams, returning a LoadResult containing the data or an error.

methods.name: getRefreshKey
methods.description: Determines the key for reloading data during a refresh based on the current PagingState.
